_doc: Bot cycle 47 (M0): canonical authority registry for the 62 Grixis decks. One canonical project list per commander; every deck starts at SOURCE_BASELINE (PENDING_RELEASE for cards not yet Commander-legal); source approvals and GrokBot cycle 39-44 refinements are evidence / challengers. APPROVED and CANONICAL_LOCKED need a human approval record (data/grixis/approvals.json). Built by scripts/grixis_authority.py --build; checked by validate_all step 'authority'. Model: grixis/Grixis Authority Model.md.

hash_definition.logical: lh1 = sha256 over UTF-8 lines '<zone>|<oracle_id>|<qty>' (zone: commander / companion / main; one line per distinct card after summing quantities), sorted, each followed by \n. Independent of file layout, line order, printings, role tags and spelling variants; changes when any card, quantity or zone changes.
hash_definition.raw: sha256 = SHA-256 of the file bytes exactly as stored. Changes with any byte (tags, order, set codes, whitespace).
hash_definition.note: The source repo mixed the two: two decks' recorded approved_list_sha256 values match no file because they are logical/list digests (source exports/archidekt_2026-10-15/README.txt). The companion stores both, under different prefixes, and only lh1 is authoritative.

M0.acceptance_evidence: In-chat approval by Cory on 2026-10-16 at 10:52 UTC ('I accept M0'), relayed to the executor by MTG Bot; recorded in Bot cycle 50.
M0.scope_note: Milestone acceptance only (M0 authority foundation, PR #120). Approves no decks: every deck keeps its state; APPROVED / CANONICAL_LOCKED still need per-deck records in data/grixis/approvals.json.
